label: Bucket Alias Binding
type: sibling of eventing:binding - grants a function access to a specific bucket/scope/collection, including wildcard scope aliases
note: A wildcard-scoped alias (e.g. source.myscope.*) can touch any collection in that scope unless the handler explicitly guards on meta.keyspace - a real safety nuance found reading the multi-collection Eventing example, not stated as a warning on the binding's own reference page.
